programme.title: Inside the Mind of a Con Artist
programme.desc: Christophe Rocancourt is a French impostor and con artist who scammed rich and powerful people by masquerading in turn as a French nobleman, the heir to the Rockefeller family, or as a Russian prince.

programme.title: Inside the Mind of a Con Artist
programme.desc: Matthew Cox is a former mortgage broker from Florida who found himself on the Secret Service's most wanted list; he made millions falsifying home ownership and mortgage documents for five times the properties' actual worth.

programme.title: Inside the Mind of a Con Artist
programme.desc: Jan Lewan is the polka sensation from Pennsylvania who fleeced millions of investors with his classic Ponzi scheme; his name shot to fame when Netflix produced the movie "Polka King" with actor Jack Black playing Jan Lewan.

programme.title: Inside the Mind of a Con Artist
programme.desc: Nicknamed The Chameleon, Frédéric Bourdin is a former French serial imposter who claims to have faked at least five hundred false identities, including a young Texas boy who went missing in the mid-90s.

programme.title: Inside the Mind of a Con Artist
programme.desc: Shaun Greenhalgh is a British artist and art forger; between 1989 and 2006, he produced a number of forgeries including Roman and Chinese art objects, and medieval Christian relics, that fooled some of the world's most respected art institutions.

programme.title: Inside the Mind of a Con Artist
programme.desc: Dubbed the "Mini Madoff," Kiener is one of Germany's greatest con artists, tricking thousands of private investors and banks, including Barclays and JP Morgan, to the tune of more than $300 million.

programme.desc: In 1930s California, a widowed farmer (Sydney Penny) tries to save her property from being seized by the bank with the help of a kindly drifter, who may be much more than he seems. Based on a novel by Lynn Austin.

programme.title: Easy Heart
programme.desc: A music teacher hires a struggling country singer to perform at her town's annual festival, but the musician's difficult behavior causes problems. The pair soon find common ground in music, however, and inspire each other to embark on new paths.

programme.title: What I Did for Love
programme.desc: After a lawyer (Jeremy London) proposes to his girlfriend (Dorie Barton), they head to her family's ranch for the holidays, where he must gain approval from her difficult dad (James Gammon) and cope with her scheming aunt (Sally Struthers), who informs her niece's ex-flame of the blossoming relationship. Mark Griffiths directed.

programme.title: Brimming With Love
programme.desc: A skeptical journalist writing a column on a matchmaking coffee shop owner agrees to be matched, but she proves to be a challenge. The reason may be that she is perfect for the matchmaker.

programme.title: Can't Buy My Love
programme.desc: Lilly, an EMT and aspiring medical student falls for Jeff, a rich, aimless guy.

programme.title: Secret Millionaire
programme.desc: A rich young man hides his identity when he discovers that he is taken by the passion of a woman who is protesting the dealings of his father's company. However, their relationship blossoms and is later on threatened.

programme.title: Heart of the Matter
programme.desc: A professional photographer visits her hometown and becomes reacquainted with a man who once broke her heart.
